crossRefs.note: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the…
He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;
and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.

translations.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
translations.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
translations.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his fathers had done.
